name: Ioto Hibiki
source:
Personality:
He is somewhat timid and afraid of interacting with others. He shows positive and bright attitude only to the protagonist. But there are times he shows gloominess too...

Rumor of Dragging Mirror:
On the landing between the first and second floors of the central staircase, there's a full length mirror on the wall, right?
Don't touch it.
Because the ghost in the mirror will drag you to the other world.

[Spoiler] His full name is Hibiki Ioto. [/spoiler]
